terminals.title: Between terminals
terminals.text: Free buses run between terminals before security; Terminals 2 and 3 are also connected by a pedestrian walkway. The circular route runs Terminal 1 → Terminal 3 → Terminal 2: journeys take approximately 14 minutes from 1 to 3, 3 minutes from 3 to 2 and 10 minutes from 2 to 1. Separate routes also connect Terminals 1 and 2, and Terminals 2 and 3.

storage.title: Self-service luggage lockers
storage.text: The airport has lockers charged by the day and by time used. For daily-rate lockers, small, medium and large sizes cost JPY 400, JPY 600 and JPY 800 respectively per day of use; a new chargeable day starts at midnight, and the maximum stay is 8 days. Time-based rates apply in the Terminal 2 main building on Level B1 and the Terminal 3 main building on Level 2: up to 6 hours costs JPY 300 for a small locker, JPY 500 for medium and JPY 600 for large; each subsequent 24 hours costs JPY 400, JPY 600 and JPY 800 respectively.

kids.title: Baby care rooms
kids.text: Baby care rooms are available in every terminal, with a breastfeeding booth, changing table, washbasin and hot water. Men can use all facilities except the breastfeeding booth.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi and power outlets
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available in every terminal and on inter-terminal buses: select FreeWiFi-NARITA and agree to the terms of use and security caution on the connection page. The service does not require advance configuration of security settings; the airport recommends a VPN for those who need a secure connection. Power outlets in the terminals are free to use.
